name: Troll Family's Rock Chocolate Bar with Pistachio Moss (Wonder Alaska)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Freezing the Night Away Menu (Alaska Sailings)
whyItWorks: Smooth chocolate-nougat mousse bar is rich and citrus-free; only the decorative green pistachio sponge/crumble needs trimming.
